name: DS-Net
full_name: DS-Net: Residual-Attention CNN for Breast Histopathology
task: Binary classification of H&E histopathology images (Benign vs Malignant)

architecture.detail: 2 x (Conv 3x3 + BN) with identity skip connection
Trunk: residual block. Mask: MaxPool, residual, bilinear upsample, residual, 1x1 Conv + sigmoid. Output = trunk x (1 + mask)
Spatial aggregation (Grad-CAM target layer is its input)

training.dataset: BreakHis-derived histopathology set, class-balanced with augmentation (10,000 images: 5,000 benign / 5,000 malignant)
training.validation: Stratified 5-fold cross-validation (seed 42), 2,000 held-out test images per fold

deployed_confusion_matrix.note: Fold 5 test split (rows = true class, columns = predicted). Positive class = Malignant.

limitations: Augmentation was applied before the k-fold split, so augmented copies of one source image can fall into both train and test folds; reported metrics are likely optimistic. A patient-level split is the correct next evaluation.
Trained on a single dataset (BreakHis); performance on other scanners and staining protocols is not guaranteed.
Research prototype - not a medical device and not for clinical diagnosis.
